claims.claim: ATI's backlog reached a record $4.4B, up 18% year over year, as aerospace and defense demand outpaced available supply; aerospace and defense represented 93% of HPMC Q2 sales.

risks.risk: Supply-constrained demand is attractive only if capacity investments qualify on time and do not create persistent cost overruns.

unknowns.unknown: Duration of aerospace/defense demand exceeding available supply remains uncertain.

claims.claim: ATI exceeded the high end of Q2 guidance: sales rose 11% to $1.26B, adjusted EBITDA rose 37% to $284M with margin expanding 440 bp to 22.6%, and management raised FY2026 adjusted EBITDA, EPS and free-cash-flow guidance.

risks.risk: Q2 included special-item charges and a $9.9M facility-sale gain; new-facility qualification requirements also raised manufacturing costs.

unknowns.unknown: Timing and economics of capacity qualification at the Mexico facility and titanium electron-beam furnace require monitoring.
